revision.v5_action: invalidated for certification after discovering that fresh_process_id embeds job identity and a per-call random nonce, making uniqueness unable to falsify reuse of one worker process across observations

measurement_validity_finding.name: job-derived observation IDs cannot attest fresh process epochs
measurement_validity_finding.finding: The v5 identifier was constructed from pid, a boot_nonce generated inside each _child call, and the unique job key. Because different jobs have different job keys and receive different per-call nonces even when executed by the same process, the identifier uniqueness check is structurally incapable of detecting worker reuse. A same-process negative control produced two different v5 IDs and therefore would pass the old uniqueness check.
measurement_validity_finding.replacement_rule: Process identity used as evidence must be stable for the worker process lifetime and independent of job identity. v6 creates one epoch nonce in the Pool initializer, hashes pid/ppid/epoch_nonce into process_epoch_id, excludes job identity, and rejects any repeated process_epoch_id across observations.

facts: spawn starts a fresh Python interpreter process
Pool initializer is called when each worker process starts
maxtasksperchild is the number of tasks a worker can complete before it exits and is replaced by a fresh worker
public_semantics_checked.purpose: supports the harness-level worker lifecycle contract; transcript-level process_epoch_id remains independently falsifiable for accidental worker reuse

validity_contract.full_certificate_gate: only after exact coverage 0-1059, 2120 globally unique process_epoch_ids, all pair/statistic digests checked, precommit schedule reverified, and raw transcript pinned

quarantined_incidents: During initial repository discovery before the repository was identified, broad GitHub searches returned unrelated semantic material. It was quarantined and not used for substantive evaluation; repository identity alone was retained for routing.

scope_limitations: The protected statistic is the role-local toy SHA-256 hash-score fixture, not an LLM runtime determinism claim.
Only 50 of 1,060 v6 challenges are captured; evidence is partial and non-certifying.
No DETERMINISTIC_REPLAY runtime is enabled from this partial evidence; FAIL_CLOSED remains the safe path.
v5 raw evidence is retained only as invalidated diagnostic material and must not be used for certificate issuance.
